name: dashboard-editor
scenario: Build a new dashboard editor: drag-and-drop chart layout, live data binding per chart, undo/redo history, cross-component state sync between the layout grid and a chart-config side panel, and persistence of the layout schema.
boundaries: Layout grid: drag-and-drop placement and resize
Chart-config side panel and its state sync with the grid
dependencies: Layout grid must land before chart-config side panel sync
Layout schema persistence depends on a stable layout grid data model
Undo/redo depends on both the grid and the config panel emitting a shared change event
invariants: The layout grid's in-memory model is the single source of truth chart-config and persistence both read from
Undo/redo never bypasses the same state-change path the UI uses
risks: If the grid's data model changes shape after persistence lands, the schema migration could force re-decomposition
phase_exit_goals: Grid: user can place and resize charts and see the change reflected in state
Config panel: editing a chart's config in the panel updates the grid live
Data binding: a chart renders live data end to end
Undo/redo: any single grid or panel change can be undone and redone
Persistence: a saved layout reloads to an identical state
